ownership types

Frequency

Frequency of the time series data: quarterly (Q) or monthly (M).

Name Value Description
Frequency.MONTHLY 'M'
Frequency.QUARTERLY 'Q'

SortOrder

Sort order of the results: ascending (asc) or descending (desc).

Name Value Description
SortOrder.ASCENDING 'asc'
SortOrder.DESCENDING 'desc'

StatTypes

Types of statistics that can be requested for the ownership breakdown. The types available are: Investor Type (1), Investment Style (2), Region (3), Rotation (4), Country (5), Metro Area (6), Investor Type Parent (7) and Investor Style Parent (8).

Name Value Description
StatTypes.INVESTOR_TYPE 1
StatTypes.INVESTMENT_STYLE 2
StatTypes.REGION 3
StatTypes.ROTATION 4
StatTypes.COUNTRY 5
StatTypes.METRO_AREA 6
StatTypes.INVESTOR_TYPE_PARENT 7
StatTypes.INVESTOR_STYLE_PARENT 8
